Current viewer configuration exposed the public service host, WFS request pattern, layer name, and EPSG:4326 output request; the configured city is Addis, not Kebri Dehar.
Official regional page describes geospatial and demographic information responsibilities and preparation of kebele, wereda, zonal, and regional maps.
Official Somali Regional State page describes the Rural Land Administration and Use Directorate and its regional land-governance role.
Official Ethio-NSDI geoportal was identified, but its TLS certificate was not trusted by the request environment; no certificate exception was authorized or used.
